metadata.method: Shuffled stratified 5-fold CV; fold-local StandardScaler, optional unwhitened PCA, Euclidean uniform-weight k-NN (k=5). Same folds for every representation.
metadata.variability: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across five fold accuracies; not a confidence interval.
metadata.accuracy_units: Fractions in [0,1]; multiply by 100 for percentages. Delta multiplied by 100 gives percentage points.
metadata.selection: k=5 fixed before comparison. k-sensitivity is descriptive; nested CV tunes k using inner training folds only.
metadata.limitations: One small historical dataset, one 5-fold partition, no external test set. Fold scores share training observations and are dependent. No statistical significance or equivalence claim is made.

pca.scope: Full-data descriptive fit; excluded from model evaluation
pca.loading_definition: Rows are principal-component unit eigenvectors; columns follow dataset.feature_names. Signs are arbitrary.

nested_cv.description: Exploratory nested CV: same five outer folds; three stratified inner folds select k from 1,3,5,7,9,11 independently for each representation. Ties select the first (smallest) k. Representation itself is not tuned.
